summary.headline: Mercury Combustion in the Triplicities
summary.text: Astrological effects of Mercury’s combustion in the airy and watery triplicities, including consequences for winds, markets, travelers, disease, ships, crops, and water; planetary aspects by Saturn, Mars, Venus, Jupiter, and the Moon modify the predictions. The text then begins the effects of Saturn’s combustion in Aries, including war, plague, mining losses, and Kharijite uprisings toward Khorasan and Isfahan.
